description_blocks.text: Note: The latest version and portable photo frames are now available on MakerWorld. For more details, click here.

Bring your images to life! By combining 3D printing technology with the PLA CMYK Lithophane Bundle, you can effortlessly design and create stunning Lithophane artworks at home. Simply use the Lithophane LED Backlight Board Kit to illuminate your creations and make them truly shine.
Start creating your lithophane with Make My Lithophane today! Make My Lithophane is also available in Bambu Handy now.

There are six types of Lithophane available on the Make My Lithophane page. Among them, Mono Lithophane with Frame and Colorful Lithophane are compatible with the Lithophane LED Backlight Board Kit. If you want to bring color to your Lithophane, please choose the Colorful Lithophane with Frame option.
Note: The latest version and portable photo frames are now available on MakerWorld, with updated supporting documents are provided below for downloading.
For more details, click here. We welcome everyone's feedback about the model to further improve it.

Smaller nozzle sizes and lower layer heights are essential to achieve better printing results. We suggest using 0.2mm or 0.4mm nozzle sizes and layer heights between 0.08mm and 0.12mm. If you use other tools to generate the lithophane model, you may need to configure the print profile to optimize the result. Please check CMYK Lithophane Printing Guide on Wiki.
Due to the limitations of printing layers and resolution, there may be some color deviation between the actual image and the lithophane prints.
To prevent warping, the recommended heated bed temperature is between 45-50℃.

Note:  The latest version and portable photo frames are now available on MakerWorld. For more details, click here.

 

 

Introduction

Bring your images to life! By combining 3D printing technology with the PLA CMYK Lithophane Bundle, you can effortlessly design and create stunning Lithophane artworks at home. Simply use the Lithophane LED Backlight Board Kit to illuminate your creations and make them truly shine.

 

Start creating your lithophane with Make My Lithophane today! Make My Lithophane is also available in Bambu Handy now. 

 

 

Bring colors to your lithophane

 

6 Lithophane Styles to Choose From

 

There are six types of Lithophane available on the Make My Lithophane page. Among them, Mono Lithophane with Frame and Colorful Lithophane are compatible with the Lithophane LED Backlight Board Kit. If you want to bring color to your Lithophane, please choose the Colorful Lithophane with Frame option.

 

Note:  The latest version and portable photo frames are now available on MakerWorld, with updated supporting documents are provided below for downloading. 

For more details, click here. We welcome everyone's feedback about the model to further improve it.

        Considerations

         

        • Smaller nozzle sizes and lower layer heights are essential to achieve better printing results. We suggest using 0.2mm or 0.4mm nozzle sizes and layer heights between 0.08mm and 0.12mm. If you use other tools to generate the lithophane model, you may need to configure the print profile to optimize the result. Please check CMYK Lithophane Printing Guide on Wiki.

        • Due to the limitations of printing layers and resolution, there may be some color deviation between the actual image and the lithophane prints.

        • To prevent warping, the recommended heated bed temperature is between 45-50℃.
